art_direction: 浅桉绿底灰蓝宽弧眼，左浅右满，松弛平视。
composition_variation: Use a broad resting pair with visible rounded bowls, never narrow slits. The left eye is two percent lower and twelve percent less open; the right is modestly fuller. Both large black pupils face forward and join gently arched upper lids. Matching slate-blue bands follow the lower contours, thinning toward soft tapered ends; add one elongated ivory glint within each pupil. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
